label: University Korean-track: TOPIK level generally expected
appliesTo: Foreign applicants to Korean-taught undergraduate programmes
why: Quoted constantly as though it were one national rule. It is a general guideline, and individual universities and departments set their own, often higher. Worth watching as a level rather than trusting as a threshold.

history.source: Study in Korea — admission and graduation guidance
history.note: The government portal indicates level 3 or above as the general entry standard for Korean-taught degree programmes and level 4 or above for graduation. Individual universities and departments may require level 4 from the entry stage, and arts, English-track, exchange and GKS routes follow different standards entirely.
